name: implement a discrete-step environment with boundary and goal reward
definition: Implement step producing an integer reward given a discrete action, moving an integer position clipped to square bounds, awarding reward when the euclidean distance to a goal is within an inclusive radius.
failure_mode: Wrong boundary clipping or reward radius gives incorrect total rewards in evaluation.

name: implement a grid-approximation Wasserstein path
definition: expose a separate estimation path that histogramizes both clouds on a grid and runs sinkhorn on the low-dimensional grid coupling.
failure_mode: disconnected grid path yields distances outside the required error band
